# Feature: Match End Mode (Standard / Zeit)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
In Spieleinstellungen (GameSetup bot phase), let the player choose how the match ends: **Standard** (to 0 LP, default) or **Zeit** (configurable minutes; on expiry higher LP wins; equal LP → Unentschieden / `draw`). Persist into `createGame` / match meta; enforce expiry in engine + a light PlayView interval.

## Preconditions
- App open on Play → Gegen Bot setup (`phase === 'bot'`)
- Spieleinstellungen modal available (`game-setup-settings`)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Modal shows match-end mode selector: „Standard“ and „Zeit“ (`data-testid="game-setup-match-mode"`)
- [ ] Default mode is Standard (to 0 Leben)
- [ ] Selecting Zeit shows minutes input (`data-testid="game-setup-timed-minutes"`), default 30, clamped 1–60
- [ ] Partie starten passes mode (+ minutes when Zeit) into createGame / match meta
- [ ] Timed match: after duration, higher LP wins; equal LP → `winner: 'draw'`
- [ ] After timeout (or draw), further plays are blocked (winner set)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Closing/reopening modal preserves mode + minutes for the setup session
- [ ] Standard mode ignores minutes field (no timer)
- [ ] LP win at 0 still ends the match during a timed game (normal checkWinner)
- [ ] MatchIntro rebuild preserves timed meta from the first createGame

## Regression
- [ ] Artefakt-Auktion / Startspieler options unchanged
- [ ] Charakterauswahl / Partie starten still work

## Assumptions
- Timer clock starts at createGame (`matchStartedAtMs`); PlayView polls ~1s; applyAction also re-checks
- Tie rule: Unentschieden (`draw`) — no forced winner
- German UI labels; English code identifiers
